title: hdl-schemview elaborated Node model
description: Serialized projection of the slang-elaborated hierarchy. This is the integration contract between the pyslang harness (producer) and the Rust core (consumer). Phase 0 emits the structural spine; drivers/loads stay empty until Phase 1.

files.description: File table; ranges reference entries by index via the `file` field.

language.description: Source language of this file (#159): "systemverilog" for elaborated RTL, or "c"/"cpp" for a high-level source referenced only by HLS provenance comments. Absent/null defaults to systemverilog. Lets the frontend pick a pane and the resolver route a cross-language probe.

edges.description: Port-connection edges: a module port wired to an external endpoint (net/var/port/interface). Direction is the port's.

select.description: Resolved bit-select on the connected expression, e.g. "[0]" or "[7:4]"; absent/null when the whole signal is connected.

mem_port.description: Memory-access role (#112): set when the edge wires a signal to a Memory node's address/data port (addr/din/dout), so the schematic draws the pin's role. Absent/null on ordinary edges.

mux_port.description: Mux-port role (#157, ADR 0005): set when the edge feeds a gate-level Mux node's select/data input (sel/d0/d1), so the schematic places it correctly. Absent/null on ordinary edges.

enums.description: Normalized enum table keyed by canonical type string (matching a node's `type`): the value->name members for FSM/enum state display. Enums with non-literal members are omitted.

source_map.description: HLS C/C++ <-> RTL provenance map (#159): a bidirectional, line-region correspondence linking a span of generated RTL to the high-level C/C++ span it came from. Populated by the harness's --hls-map pass from the line-annotated provenance comments HLS tools write into the generated RTL. The single source of truth for C<->RTL source cross-probing (a lookup, not a heuristic). Absent/empty when no provenance comments are found.

source.description: Span in the high-level (c/cpp) source file.

width.description: Bit width of the enum base type.

name.description: Member signal name within the interface.

dir.description: Direction of the member through this modport view.

symbol_key.description: Stable per-symbol key; absorbs generate/param expansion.

dir.description: Declared direction for Port nodes (drives schematic pin side); null otherwise.

const.description: Literal or resolved parameter value tied to an input (a Port input, or a gate operand via a Const/Param node, e.g. "32'd0"); null if driven by a net.

modport.description: View name on a modport-specialized interface port (e.g. "mem" for `mem_if.mem bus`); null otherwise.

reset.description: FF only: canonical path of the async-reset signal — the timing-control edge whose signal the process body also reads (#59). Absent/null when the FF has no async reset or the rule cannot disambiguate.

enable.description: Latch only: canonical path of the gating (enable) signal — the sole signal read by the body's top-level conditional (#59). Absent/null when no single gating signal exists.

members.description: Membership of a Modport node: each bundle member visible through the view, with its direction (slang ModportPort.direction). Descriptive metadata -- the modport stays a view; the member's own node lives in the parent interface instance at `<parent path>.<name>`. Absent/null on non-modport nodes.

mem_depth.description: Memory only: word count of the array (unpacked dimension size, e.g. 512 for `ram [0:511]`), a structural fact from slang used to label the MEMORY glyph. Absent/null on non-memory nodes (#112).

init_source.description: Memory only: the $readmemh/$readmemb initializer's source-file argument text (e.g. "INIT_FILE"); presence drives the INIT marker. From the harness's initial-block scan -- initial stays non-logic (ADR 0004). Absent/null when the memory has no $readmem* initializer (#112).

op.description: Gate-level datapath primitives only (#157, ADR 0005): the exact operator behind a coarse Add/Sub/Mul/Cmp/Shift kind (e.g. "LessThan", "LogicalShiftLeft"), for the box label. Absent/null on non-gate nodes and on bitwise/reduction gates whose kind already names them.
